in_marathi.name: Meher
in_marathi.long_meaning: Meher हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Meher is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'radiant light'. In Hindu mythology, Meher is associated with the god of the sun, Surya, and represents the divine energy that illuminates the world. The name is a symbol of purity, wisdom, and strength, and is believed to bring blessings of good health, wealth, and success.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'māhār', meaning 'great'. The goddess Meher, also known as Mahishasuramardini, is a popular Hindu goddess who embodies strength and courage. She is depicted riding a lion and holding a trishula and a chakra. She is known to have slain the demon Mahishasura.
